note: The main banks: Ålandsbanken, the islands' own and largest bank, is the one whose card price list was read; the Finnish banks also serving Åland publish Finland's terms, and no source read shows them for Åland. Ålandsbanken's card price list (read 30 October 2026): its Credit and Credit/Debit cards cost 45 euros a year; credit carries the 3-month Euribor plus 9.5%. The price list doesn't give the Euribor's value, so the sum is taken on the European Central Bank's monthly average of the 3-month Euribor for September 2026, 2.6350455%: 12.1350455% a year, written as 12.14. A cash withdrawal in euros on the credit function costs 1.50 euros plus 2% (in another currency 2.00 plus 3%, not written), with interest from the day of withdrawal; spending in another currency carries a 1.95% currency surcharge; going over the credit limit costs 10 euros; a reminder for an unpaid credit card invoice sent by post costs 5 euros, written as the late fee. The fees for paper invoices, payment plan and limit changes and copies, met only on request, aren't written; the price list states no minimum payment or grace period. This file kept the card read on 29 October 2026; its rate, then taken on the April 2026 Euribor of 2.08% that Nordea's card page gave (11.58%), is now taken on September 2026's. Wave 4 (30 October 2026): no bank was added. Andelsbanken för Åland (OP Ahvenanmaa) didn't answer, and OP's and Nordea's Finnish card and price list addresses answered not found. No minimum payment share is published for Ålandsbanken Credit; tried: its card price list (read again 2026-10-30, none stated) and its standard European consumer credit information for Mastercard cards (read 2026-10-30), which makes the monthly instalment an agreed percentage of the balance, at least 30 euros, with interest and fees on top, without stating the percentage.
